album.title: you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love [Explicit]

wiki.summary: ‘maggots for brains’ is the fourth track off Olivia Rodrigo’s third studio album, ‘you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love’. Inspired by Sex and The City’s Miranda Hobbes, ‘maggots for brains’ compares lovesickness and codependency to having a rotting brain, being practically catatonic and unable to function properly without her partner. Prior to the release of the album, Rodrigo would tease the lyrics of the song via an encore shirt at Lollapalooza in Chicago. Read more on Last.fm.

The title was officially announced on May 26th, 2026, eventually being released on June 12th, 2026, along with the rest of the album. Read more on Last.fm.
